purpose: Answer Major comment 2 of the review: do the three fragment constants (delta, eta, beta) catastrophically fail when they interact?
status: pre-registered before any grid cell was evaluated

grid.beta_ties: fragment_closeness_factor == fragment_corridor_factor == beta (as in Table 1 of the manuscript)
grid.range_justification: each ratio covers its full plausible interval, default at the centre; fixed before results

unsw_v2_replication.role: primary validation cohort (development/validation; not the untouched holdout)

development_suite.role: semantic risk (Digits-Rare) and the only set with a fragment edge at defaults (SplitRare)

excluded.unsw_holdout_v1: 20 untouched holdout blocks; not evaluated at any non-default configuration, so the one-shot blind protocol is preserved

H1_no_catastrophe.rule: for every grid cell: pooled median delta rare-recall >= -0.01 AND every UNSW block has delta rare-recall >= -0.10 AND delta ARI >= -0.05 (all relative to the default configuration)
H1_no_catastrophe.falsified_by: any grid cell violating either part

H2_no_hidden_compensation.rule: in the 9x7x5 decomposition of total fragment edges, the three-way interaction term explains < 5% of total sum of squares and the three main effects together explain >= 80%

H3_plateau.rule: at least 90% of the 315 cells reproduce the default partition (identical label hash) on every unit of all three cohorts
H3_plateau.falsified_by: fewer than 284 cells are identical on all units

H4_semantic_safety.rule: no cell merges the two rare Digits classes: ARI >= default ARI - 0.001 and rare-recall >= default rare-recall - 0.001 on Digits-Rare
H4_semantic_safety.falsified_by: any cell violating either bound on Digits-Rare

reported_regardless_of_outcome: per-cell paired deltas against the default on every unit
count of cells that change any partition
worst block delta ARI and delta rare-recall over the grid
fragment edge count over the grid (operator-level response)
sum-of-squares decomposition of the edge response
every H1-H4 violation located to its cell and unit

statistics.multiplicity: none; the grid is a coverage check of the null region, not 315 hypothesis tests
statistics.replicates: none; data are frozen and the pipeline is deterministic

implementation_check.equivalence: at least 10% of the cells re-run through MGGBC.fit_predict; label sha256 must match the cached-state path, otherwise the run aborts
